recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: old e-ink tablets waking from a four-year sleep
roman merchant ship resurfacing off the sicily coast
ai data centers quietly expanding into small towns
summer fog rolling through san francisco at thirteen degrees
shipping by sunrise from a phone in your pocket

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Merge scattered thought bubbles into a single latent orb before they overflow — each fusion reveals a fragment of ghost text from a dormant feed.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one clean merge chain feels like a micro epiphany in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: bubbles spawn faster and colors invert as latent space compresses
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome e-ink with slow ink-bleed trails

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Salvage amphorae from a sunken roman wreck by flicking rope hooks through shifting underwater currents.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each haul unlocks a tile in a mosaic that completes in one round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: currents strengthen and debris blocks your arc mid-flight

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Revive a dead reMarkable screen by rhythm-tapping pixels back to life in the correct pulse sequence before the refresh ghost fades.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: tap in time with expanding pulse rings
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: every revived pixel reveals one line of buried notes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: pulse tempo accelerates and dead zones spread outward from edges
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: grayscale tablet paper with sluggish refresh flicker

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sail a one-thumb boat through rolling san francisco fog banks at sunset, collecting silver light before the sky goes dark.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left or right to slip between fog corridors
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: threading a narrow clearing at golden hour triggers a perfect-run multiplier
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog thickens and wind randomly shifts lane positions
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: muted summer twilight gradient with soft particulate haze
